name: KineticDock
tagline: 叠放、放大、滚筒与转盘，让 iPhone 程序坞动起来。
description: 灵动程序坞为 iPhone Dock 提供叠放、放大、滚筒和转盘四种模式。滚筒只显示当前一段图标，两端逐渐缩小；转盘按可用宽度展开圆弧，图标随盘移动与倾斜。快速滑动后惯性减速并自动吸附，轻点图标即可打开应用。
可通过独立应用列表选择与排序最多 24 个应用；列表为空时跟随原生 Dock。关闭插件可恢复原生界面。
features: 叠放：前后层次、惯性减速、自动吸附与旋转位置保存
放大模式：中心最大、两侧递减；空间不足自动缩小避让，支持松手打开与移出取消
滚筒：单排滚动、两端渐小，无后排图标
转盘：按 Dock 宽度调整图标与圆弧布局，随盘移动和倾斜
滚筒与转盘严格限制在 Dock 圆角边界内显示
独立应用列表，最多 24 个应用并支持排序
调整图标大小、放大倍数、栏位置、名称、光晕、背景与触感，显示通知徽标
长按进入系统桌面编辑，支持拖动手柄调整自定义栏位置
简体中文、繁体中文与英文设置，跟随系统语言
compatibility: 普通 Dock / 已开启的浮动 Dock
notice: 浮动 Dock 需由其他插件开启。iPhone 15 Pro / iOS 17.3.1 已获用户反馈确认；iOS 15/16 尚未完成真机验证。不接管 iPad、横屏或外接屏，不扩容原生 Dock。
usage: 安装后进入“设置 → 灵动程序坞”，开启总开关。
选择“叠放”“放大”“滚筒”或“转盘”模式，按需调整外观与交互选项。
在“应用列表”中选择和排序应用；清空列表即可跟随原生 Dock。
叠放、滚筒和转盘模式轻点图标打开应用，快甩后继续滚动，再次按住可接管。放大模式可按住横滑后松手打开。

changes: 修复从其他 App 返回桌面后，Dock 偶发无法拖动或旋转的问题。
改善四种模式的拖动恢复与手势响应，保留现有动画、惯性和点击行为。
新增滚筒与转盘模式，原“横向滚动”更名为“叠放”，保留 Mac 放大。
转盘按 Dock 可用宽度调整图标与圆弧布局，展示更多应用；滚筒两端图标逐渐缩小。
滚筒、转盘限制在 Dock 圆角边界内显示，保留惯性滚动、自动吸附与轻点打开。
优化 Mac 放大模式的滑动与放大性能，减少卡顿和掉帧。
优化通知徽标与选中光晕的显示效率，保留现有图标避让和交互效果。
优化放大模式：中间最大、两侧递减，密集图标自动缩小并避让，减少重叠。
横向转盘根据应用数量与可用空间调整图标大小，同步优化点击范围和徽标显示。
调整应用最小化时图标的垂直落点，保留惯性滚动与自动吸附。
首个正式版，支持横向转盘与放大两种模式，横向滑动支持惯性减速和自动吸附。
支持应用选择与排序，可调整图标大小、位置、名称显示与触感反馈。
支持 iPhone 普通 Dock 与已开启的浮动 Dock，提供简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置。

en.name: KineticDock
en.tagline: Stack, Magnification, Drum, and Turntable for your iPhone Dock.
description: KineticDock adds four iPhone Dock modes: Stack, Magnification, Drum, and Turntable. Drum scrolls a single visible strip with smaller icons toward the edges. Turntable adapts its arc to the available width, with icons moving and tilting together. Flick to coast and snap into place, or tap an icon to open.
Choose and reorder up to 24 apps in a separate list, or leave it empty to follow the native Dock. Turning KineticDock off restores the native interface.
features: Stack with depth, inertia, snapping, and saved rotation
Magnification with graduated icon sizes, adaptive spacing, optional release-to-open, and move-away cancellation
Drum with a single scrolling strip and smaller edge icons, without a rear row
Turntable with width-adaptive icons and arc, moving and tilting with the disk
Drum and Turntable stay within the rounded Dock boundary
A separate, reorderable list of up to 24 apps
Adjust icon size, magnification, bar position, labels, glow, background, and haptics; display notification badges
Hold for native Home Screen editing and drag the handle to move the custom bar
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings follow the system language
compatibility: Standard Dock / externally enabled Floating Dock
en.notice: A separate tweak is required to enable the Floating Dock. User feedback confirmed operation on iPhone 15 Pro / iOS 17.3.1; iOS 15/16 have not completed device validation. iPad, landscape, and external displays are not taken over. Native Dock capacity is not expanded.
usage: Open Settings → KineticDock after installation and turn on the main switch.
Choose Stack, Magnification, Drum, or Turntable, then adjust appearance and interaction options.
Select and reorder apps under Applications; leave the list empty to follow the native Dock.
In Stack, Drum, and Turntable, tap to open and flick to keep scrolling; touch again to take control. In Magnification, slide and release to open.

changes: Fixed an issue where the Dock could stop dragging or rotating after returning to the Home Screen from another app.
Improved drag recovery and gesture responsiveness across all four modes while preserving animations, inertia, and tap behavior.
Added Drum and Turntable modes; renamed Scrolling to Stack while keeping Mac-style Magnification.
Turntable adapts icons and its arc to the available Dock width to show more apps; Drum icons shrink toward both edges.
Drum and Turntable stay within the rounded Dock boundary, with inertia, snapping, and tap-to-open.
Improved sliding and magnification performance in Mac-style Magnification mode to reduce stuttering and dropped frames.
Improved rendering efficiency for notification badges and selection glow while preserving adaptive icon spacing and interactions.
Improved Magnification with a larger center icon, progressively smaller neighbors, and adaptive spacing to reduce overlap.
The scrolling carousel now adapts icon sizes to app count and available space, with matching hit areas and scaled badges.
Adjusted vertical icon targets when minimizing apps, while preserving inertial scrolling and snapping.
First stable release with Scrolling and Magnification modes, including inertial scrolling and automatic snapping.
Choose and reorder apps; adjust icon size, position, labels, and haptic feedback.
Supports the standard iPhone Dock and an externally enabled Floating Dock, with English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings.
